structured_output.what_is_happening: A 37-minute-old pump.fun token called "Pump Agent" ($PUMPAGENT), still on the bonding curve, rose about 160-215% to an all-time high near $24k market cap and then fell about 43-49% in the last 5 minutes to about $11.4k. The rule fired on a 5-minute volume spike, and that spike is mostly selling. GeckoTerminal counts 27 unique sellers against 9 unique buyers in the last 5 minutes, and 34% of the price has gone in 15 minutes. GMGN flags 46 bundler wallets and 46 fresh wallets, with bundlers holding about 29% of trader supply. It has a website and an X account with no rename history, no paid DexScreener promotion, and no smart-money or KOL wallets.

narrative.description: A generic 'AI agent on pump.fun' name. Tokens in this category launch in large numbers every day, and nothing in the packet sets this one apart. It has a .space website and an X handle but no description and no known backer.
narrative.why_spreading: It is not clearly spreading. The early burst looks like bundled launch activity plus the usual traders who buy new launches, and that burst has already turned into selling.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only pair found, and the X account and website are linked to it. But the name is generic, so any story could easily attach to a different token.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 46 bundler wallets and 46 fresh wallets, bundlers hold about 29% of trader supply, and the bot/degen rate is 47%. Top holders are evenly sized at 2-3.3% each, which is typical of bundled wallets. GMGN page visits are very low (8). There are no smart or renowned wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: The creator holds only 1.3% and has no history of rugging. Some of the buying could be organic but small-scale. There is no X data.

structural_risks: Bundlers hold about 29% and can keep selling into the thin curve
It has already fallen about 50% from its ATH, and recent sellers outnumber buyers about 3 to 1
At about $11k market cap the curve is shallow: a -50% stop sits near $5.7k, not far above the curve floor, and it is easy to reach
Doubling from entry needs a new high above the prior $24k ATH, into supply from holders who bought near the top
The name is a generic AI-agent theme with no sign of anything that would drive fresh buying

structured_output.counterargument: Tokens on the bonding curve can't have liquidity pulled. The dev holds very little and has no rug history. Real links exist, and 199 unique buyers in the first hour is decent for a coin at $11k. If the bundlers have mostly finished selling, a second leg driven by a KOL or an X post could easily take a $10k coin to $25k+, so a 2x from a low entry is not unusual on pump.fun.

structured_output.thesis: A generic AI-agent pump.fun launch with heavy bundling. It has already hit its first peak and is now falling on majority selling. The odds of doubling from entry before a -50% stop are low, and fading or dying on the curve is the likely outcome.
